d:
This wild story (may or may not be inspired from real life) is the wild card entry of the show. My comedy special “Professor of Tomfoolery” goes through a massive change in tone with this bit. I was initially going to remove this from the special but every time I performed the tale of Charulata, people came again for the show with their friends and family to listen to this bit again!
I hope you have fun watching this bit as much as I enjoyed writing and performing it.
